ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food web, with Mongoose labeled in the top middle and Lizard labeled on the right. A blue arrow can be seen extending from the Mongoose position and pointing to the Lizard on the right. The figure also has arrows from Duck to Plants, Fish, Ants, etc., indicating that the arrows here mean the animal at the starting point of the arrow will eat or affect the organism that the arrow points to. Reasoning: Since the arrow from Mongoose points to Lizard, it indicates that Mongoose is a predator of Lizard. If all Mongoose die from disease, the predation pressure on Lizard will decrease, so the number of Lizard will most likely rise.
